string.text: What are you doing here?
Hello, Gunslinger. I knew you'd be here, I think my help will definitely come in handy for you. Ready to head to the bunker entrance?
Hm, alright, let's go, assistant.
Let's go.
Come on, let's hurry!
Let's go...
What's up?
Oh, it's you, finally. We were starting to worry a bit. Come on, they've been waiting for us.
What's the matter, who are you?
Everything's fine, don't worry.
Let's go...

Greetings, Gunslinger. We are the "C-Consciousness" — a project by a group of researchers who decided to do everything in their power to change the world. We have evaluated your ability and believe you have earned the right to join us. To dispel your distrust, we are prepared to answer any questions you may have.
What is the "C-Consciousness" project?

The "Common Consciousness" project is based on the concept of forging a distinct "connection" between multiple human consciousnesses and merging them into a single, cohesive entity that possesses a unified will and harnesses the combined processing power of the subjects' brain neurons. \n \nThe researchers leading the project hypothesized that such an entity could exert a remote influence not only on specific, pivotal individuals who play key roles in human society, but also on the masses that comprise it. To a certain extent, these objectives were achieved.
What is the Zone? How did it come into existence?

We cannot fully answer these questions. A surge of anomalous energy occurred when the "C-Consciousness" entered its active operational phase; however, the root cause of this phenomenon remains unknown to us. \n \nSince the very first day of our existence, all our resources have been dedicated to containing the expansion of the Zone and ensuring the security of the project. We lack the capacity to address any tasks outside of this scope.
Was the 1986 catastrophe your work, too?
No, the experiments under the "С-Consciousness" project began only after the accident at the Chernobyl NPP. That said, certain other experiments were conducted in this area even before the accident.
What are the death trucks?

This is the transport used to deliver our agents to various parts of the Zone. Unfortunately, the Zone is extremely unstable, which means some agents never reach their intended destinations. The others integrate into the community of stalkers and, without even realizing it, carry out the tasks for which they were programmed.
What does the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. tattoo stand for?

S.T.A.L.K.E.R. is the name of a program designed to condition individuals to carry out specific tasks. As part of the "Barrier" project, the center of the Zone was surrounded by a network of psychotronic emitters, shielding the "Center" laboratory from incursions by hostile individuals. \n \nStalkers who fall under the influence of these emitters become part of the defensive system. Those whose consciousness proves particularly resistant to the psi-emission undergo conditioning and become our agents. A marking tattoo serves as an identifier, preventing an agent from being subjected to the conditioning process again.
What happened to me?

An accident, brought about by flaws in the security system. You managed to discover a path whose existence we hadn’t suspected, and it got you far too close to us. We couldn’t allow that; consequently, our agents were tasked with your immediate elimination. \n \nAt one point, you ended up among the ranks of our agents and, since the system is not designed to recognize the subjects it encodes, you were programmed to kill yourself.
Why did you choose this area for your experiments?

The Chernobyl Exclusion Zone was the most suitable location for our experiments. First, following the 1986 accident, the majority of the population was evacuated, and military cordons provided a degree of protection against the entry of outsiders, thus ensuring a certain level of privacy for our experiments. Second, the power units that remained operational at the plant generated a sufficient supply of energy, which could be utilized at our own discretion. Third, there were already secret facilities in operation within the Zone, many of which aligned with our objectives.
What happens next?
What happens next depends on you. The Zone is expanding. Slowly, but steadily. Our resources are barely enough to contain this expansion.

You could join us. Our resources would increase, and perhaps we'll be able to bring the Zone under control. If that were to happen, we could focus on eliminating the root causes of the catastrophe. After that we could return to our original plans for perfecting this world. \n \nAlternatively, you could destroy us. In that case, the only obstacle to the spread of the Zone would be removed. What that would lead to, we cannot say.
No, I refuse to join you.
I agree to join the "C-Consciousness".
Where... Where am I?
What? Who are you... How did you pass the checkpoint? It's chaos over there...
I... I remember disabling the installations... The brain link is destroyed... I need to get out of the Zone urgently. I have information about what's going on behind the station!
Where? Wait, were you affected by the installations up North? You're not zombified, are you, kid? Answer!
I was there, behind the station, in the Generator area! I managed to sneak into the lab, they're there... They're behind everything that's happening here! I need to leave the Zone.
You won't get through the checkpoints and patrols in this state for sure. You know what? It's better for you to leave now... I don't know you, so just go.
Hello, Messer!
What? Who are you?
Quiet, quiet, it's all over now...
What?!
